decisions.reason: The mitred handle family is a sizeable investment in tooling and range development, and it has stayed visible on the website in both years, so management is likely to persist with it rather than admit an early misjudgment.
Visibility rose from a mention to a page of its own in 2024, which signals growing public commitment and investment that management will want to justify.

It is only mentioned on the website and has no reported results, but the sunk tooling costs and its fit with the firm's core handle range favour keeping it while weak results are put down to normal market ramp-up.
The award-winning collection has its own page, is publicly promoted with German Design and iF awards, and is central to the firm's design positioning, so dropping it is highly unlikely.
